# Accu-Track Financial Solutions

> Accu-Track Financial Solutions is an outsourced contract and licensing operations firm, founded in 1990, that runs contract management, royalty reporting, and licensing compliance for US companies managing complex contract and licensing portfolios. A dedicated team does the work, with no software to implement and no headcount to hire.

## What we do

Accu-Track takes the operational work of contracts and licensing off a company's plate: royalty reporting and reconciliation, licensing compliance and obligation tracking, contract administration (renewals, amendments, terminations), post-acquisition contract cleanup, and centralized portfolio visibility. We act as an extension of a client's finance and legal teams, not a replacement, and the client keeps all decision-making authority.

We are an alternative to contract-lifecycle-management (CLM) software and to hiring internal staff. Software still requires people to run it; hiring is slow and expensive. Accu-Track simply does the work.

## Who we work with

US enterprise and mid-market companies, typically managing 50 or more active contracts or licensing agreements: licensors and licensees across retail, manufacturing, consumer products, and distribution; finance and legal operations teams; and private-equity or corporate-development teams handling post-merger contract integration. Past and current clients include Procter & Gamble, Chemours, Newell Brands, DuPont, and bCreative.

## Proof

On one inherited licensing portfolio, within four months: $27.6M collected, 52% of it directly attributable to Accu-Track's management, including 14% from payers the client did not know existed and 38% that had been paid late or incorrectly.

## How to engage

Start with a free 30-minute operations assessment. A specialist reviews the current contract landscape and gives an honest read on whether outsourcing makes sense. If there is a fit, a custom scope and proposal follow, and most engagements are operational within 2 to 4 weeks.
